title: An Object Made Tangible
summary: From an early sketch to a tested, held, and useful physical thing.
body:
Show the path from an idea on screen to an object in hand. This is a good place for sketches, prototypes, failures, and the final print.

## Iteration is the work

Explain what changed between versions and how using the object revealed things the model could not.

## A small resolution

End with the final object, its purpose, and what you want to explore in the next version.
